usage: You use '兩個' (loeng5 go3) to indicate the quantity of two items in Cantonese.
'兩個' can describe people, objects, or any countable items.
It's usually placed before the noun it describes, similar to 'two' in English.
'個' (go3) is a common measure word used after numbers and before nouns in Cantonese.
When counting things, '兩個' is the standard way to say 'two' with the measure word '個'.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 maai5 zo2 loeng5 go3 ping4 gwo2.
loeng5 go3 jan4 jat1 cai4 sik6 faan6.
keoi5 dei6 jau5 loeng5 go3 sau2 gei1.
cing2 bei2 ngo5 loeng5 go3 bui1.
